release_notes:
🚀 v0.1.4 Series Episode Resolution, Download Quality Fallback & Multi-Season Routing
• Series Episode Download Resolution: Fixed an issue where TV and Anime episodes beyond Episode 1 defaulted to Episode 1's streams
• Download Quality Sheet Episode Synthesis: Automatically synthesizes target episode and season queries when episode counts are unlisted, eliminating silent fallbacks
• TV Season & Multi-Episode Routing: Wired season numbers from player and detail views through the download options sheet
• Batch Download Multi-Episode Resolving: Ensured every episode in a batch queue resolves its own unique stream URL instead of cloning the first episode
• Serverless Worker TV MultiEmbed & VidLink Hardening: Added tmdb=1 parameter to MultiEmbed for TV episodes and guarded against null stream payloads
